1.Clue:
Once when I was in Oakenfell, I heard the performances of many excellent musicians in the streets and alleys. 
    The most memorable moments are always messy, but full of joy and imaginative... melody, right? 
    But where did I hear it again? I seem to remember a little girl holding a broom.
 
 [Hint: Character Portraits]
1.Story:
Melody Search Day 1
 
    I visited the mansion of the nobleman, following a wonderous melody, and ran into a little servant girl cleaning the piano room.
    I don't know what happened exactly, but the grand piano, violins and other musical instruments piled in the corner of the room suddenly seemed to have minds of their own and started moving... 
    Then, I heard... like a spiritual stallion in the sky... an unforgettable melody. How interesting...
1.Tips: ...Ah yes, I remember now. It was a shy, blue-eyed girl in the mansion of a nobleman...she had a surprise for me.

2.Clue:
I once met a dwarf who loved to drink on the docks of the Empire's Seaport.
    He often got drunk when the ships anchored in, and yelled at sailors in that rough and loud voice of his.
    Oh... I wonder where he is now?
 
[Hint: The Oak Inn]
2.Story:
Melody Search Day 2
 
    Esperia, where the people are so full of emotions... anger, sorrow, joy... 
    Listening to sailors sing of the sea, I tasted the sorrow of life and feelings of nostalgia.
     Alas...life just gets harder as we get older...
2.Tips: Hahaha, this familiar, loud voice reminds me of the salty sea breeze on the docks...how nostalgic...

3.Clue:
My old friend Dolly is a very good bartender. In her hands, "The Dark Forest" exudes a fragrance of dewdrops, and "Romantic Savannah" has a hint of the sweetness of love... 
But which one I should i order to get inspired?But which one should I order to get inspired?
 
 [Hint: The Noble Tavern]
3.Story:
Melody Search Day 3
 
    I often indulge in getting drunk. There are always people coming and going in the pub, and I have seen and heard all kinds of things.
    But I never forget why I set off on my journey.
    Freedom is the source of my inspiration.
    Everyone, a toast to freedom!
3.Tips: ...Now I remember... it was "Oakenfell Libre". Haha, an interesting name for a cocktail...

4.Clue:
I have traveled to many human cities, and sometimes I get tired of the noise and crowds.
    I was fortunate enough to make friends with a Wilder whom I traveled to the edge of Yggdrasil with. 
    The wind in the jungle seems to have a hint of music to it.
 
 [Hint: World Map]
4.Story:
Melody Search Day 4
 
    I have traveled to many human cities, and sometimes I get tired of the noise and crowds.
The mountains and rivers can be a relaxing reprieve from the bustling city life, and always brings me peace of mind. 
    The wind in the jungle seems to have a hint of music to it.
    Yggdrasil is a cool and windy place, and I'm afraid I'll never get to see my Wilder friend again...
4.Tips: I sense a fragrance of flowers in the breeze...hmm, and the song of birds.

5.Clue:
Occasionally, eating and sleeping on the streets can instill some good inspiration, but wandering artists still need food and shelter.
    I have a friend who runs a Trading Hub. When I was desperately in need, he lent a helping hand.
    I wonder what he's been up to? 
 
 [Hint: Trading Hub]
5.Story:
Melody Search Day 5
 
    Hmm...when things aren't going my way, the Trading Hub is also a good place to go to pawn things for coin.
    I'm really embarrassed to admit it, but the clinking of silver and gold is music to my ears. To some people, this is the most beautiful sound in the world...
5.Tips: Hahaha, looks like he hasn't changed at all.

6.Clue:
I have been to the magnificent church. When the sunlight pours down on the ivory floors, through the stained glass windows, I can hear the chants of the heavens...
 
 [Hint: Temple of Ascension]
6.Story:
Melody Search Day 6
 
    I was passing by the church that day and was attracted by a burst of light and music.
    The expressions of the believers when they pray were so sincere and heartwarming.
    Alas, I have no faith... If I had to choose, Harry and I would probably pray to the goddess of music. That way, we can live and get drunk off music!

7.Clue:
I went to the border, where I met two soldiers. Wonder where they are now...
    ...or what they're fighting for...
 
 [Hint: Campaign]
7.Story:
Melody Search Day 7
 
    I once traveled to the bleak borders, hoping to bring comfort and song to the units garrisoned there.
    It was also there that I became acquainted with two soldiers.
    Countless fearless men just like them make up the Empire's defenses, which is why we can gather like this today at The Noble Tavern.
 
    Epilogue
 
    I sometimes feel that memory is like an ocean, abundant in glittering stars. A shooting star is that moment that evades your grasp, slipping away. Their eternal light and heat has become something entirely too familiar.
    Inspiration is concealed in that light. Music can be extracted from any part of it, and thus, the journey of Angelo will be long and joyous.
    Right... This minuet is a gift for the shy lass. This choreographed number is in honor of my vocal brother. Later I'll write something romantic, and then something liberating! Haha!
    Don't forget to keep two coins jingling in your pocket! When you're starving it's going to be of more use than mere pocket chimes.
    Sing of devotion, praise bravery, and finally... Allow me and my lyre to tirelessly create pieces. Hmm... Is something missing? Oh, right! I couldn't possibly forget my lovely Harry!
    To meet, to accompany, to the future, to the past.
    To them, to us.
    You gave to me, and I gave to you.
    Friends come and go, but Angelo's journey is not yet over.
    I would like to dedicate this song to all the friends who have accompanied me on my way!
7.Tips: When dawn came, the embers of the bonfire had not yet cooled down. The horns of battle sounded, and it was an exhilarating and fearless melody.

1.Clue:
Whenever I've got a free afternoon, I'll visit this place to peruse their books. If you keep your mind open and your mouth closed, the gates of knowledge will open wide for you.
 
[Hint: Try looking around Ranhorn]
1.Story: One must never stop learning, so that one may never stop growing.
1.Tips: Sometimes, we can only learn about the outside world through books. But given the opportunity, we must venture out there and see the world for ourselves. As the Church says, wisdom is the fruit of experience.

2.Clue:
I have a love-hate relationship with the place where they post bounties. The assignments spell endless trouble, yet promise lucrative rewards.
 
[Hint: Try searching the buildings in the Dark Forest]
2.Story: May the future be free from pain and suffering, and may every day be filled with peace and happiness.
2.Tips: Sometimes I wonder: would fewer bounties posted mean that the world was safer and less troubled? But if that were the case, bounty hunters like us would be out of a job.

3.Clue:
Every Spring Spree, I always visit my red-haired friend. There are always throngs of customers turning up for the drinks she makes.
 
[Hint: Try looking around Ranhorn]
3.Story: Those who work hard will be rewarded. Here's hoping that everybody will strike it rich in the year ahead!
3.Tips: Over the past year, so much has happened and my business has suffered. Thankfully, crowds are returning to the streets, and they've got money to spend!

4.Clue:
Some battles take place outside the battlefield, and not every opponent is an enemy. When I crave a battle against worthy foes, I can always find one in this glorious colosseum.
 
[Hint: Try searching the buildings in the Dark Forest]
4.Story: Be grateful for every day you are healthy, and take good care of yourself even in times of battle.
4.Tips: Nothing is more important than health and strength. With a healthy body, I can beat all opponents!

5.Clue:
I've entrusted my wish to someone reliable. If you know him well, you'd know that he's the best house steward in Oakenfell.
 
[Hint: Try looking through hero portraits]
5.Story: Everything will be fine as long as you have your family around you.
5.Tips: Lady Vala, His Lordship, Sir Teapot, Miss Teacup, Grandpa Fork, Mister Plate, and… Oscar––these are the family I cherish the most, the ones who've always been by my side.

6.Clue:
I've been to many places, but the place I long for the most is the tallest peak in a snow-covered realm, where the gods are said to live.
 
[Hint: Try looking at the world map]
6.Story: Hang out with a few friends and travel together on a sunny day.
6.Tips: For a number of reasons, we've had to stop traveling recently. Fortunately, we'll soon be able to set off on new adventures.

7.Clue:
Pippa's wish is gone! She must have lost it when picking magic seeds in the woods. We need to find it, fast!
 
[Hint: Try looking in the Peaks of Time]
7.Story: No more mistakes, in work or life. Remember to have fun in between your busy schedule.
7.Tips: Everyone makes mistakes. As long as we find the root of an error in time, we can nip it in the bud.

1.Clue:
When I have free time, I often reminisce about my past, which can be quite rewarding.
 
[Hint: Try looking around the Dark Forest]
1.Story: You and I are bearers of the light of destiny. Fear no hardship and never lose heart. Advance ever forward and hold in your heart both the glories and sufferings of days gone by, so that you may light the torch of hope amidst the darkness of the night.
1.Tips: Steadfast as a sacred shield and faithful as the morning light, may you always find your path forward through the darkness.

2.Clue:
The thing we Durri love most about humans is that they've always got a place to stash tons of gold.
 
[Hint: Try looking around Ranhorn]
2.Story: Look here! Who dares to barge into my "workplace"? Lots of people want to catch the wind, but only the sharpest can seize it first—like me!
2.Tips: Light feet and a nimble mind will attract great opportunities, helping you to become unstoppable.

3.Clue:
It is the mission of the Mauler warrior to embark on one journey after another. If you can't find me anywhere else, come and join me on my endless path of self-growth.
 
[Hint: Try looking around in the Campaign]
3.Story: Victory belongs not only to the strong, but to those who refuse to give up. The enemy might outpower you, but that just means you need to be more determined than they are. Endure hunger, brave the bitter wind, and brace yourself against despair, as only the unyielding spirit can survive the flames of war.
3.Tips: May your spirit be as robust as the war drum; may your footsteps stamp out every obstacle; and may your roar herald victory.

4.Clue:
Guarding the forest is my central mission, and every day I examine the orders given by the Oak Sages.
 
[Hint: Try looking around in quests]
4.Story: The arrow finds its target every time not because there are no obstacles, but because the archer never wavers. Focus on your objective and remain patient, as there is meaning in every step of the journey.
4.Tips: May the forest's protection be always with you, and may you be blessed with vision keen as an arrowhead and a mind as serene as the verdant grove.

5.Clue:
While the Dark Forest is my home, I can make friends with people around the world in my dreams.
 
[Hint: Try looking around amongst friends]
5.Story: Dreams are incredible, aren't they? They're places where every star and every cloud can be your friend.
5.Tips: Under the watchful eye of the dreamland's stars, every shadow dissolves in the night to welcome a morning that's all yours.

6.Clue:
The world changes all the time, with new opportunities everywhere. Get involved and stay mindful of time and you're sure to make a breakthrough.
 
[Hint: Try looking around in events]
6.Story: A warrior's mind must not be disturbed by the chaos of the battlefield, but rather be prepared for every possibility. Everything is an opportunity to hone your skills, and all things can be the first step toward victory.
6.Tips: The warhorse fears not the road ahead. Its battle flag flies high as it dashes closer to glory with every step.

7.Clue:
Since leaving the Dark Forest, I've witnessed every season across the continent. The more I travel, the more hope I have for the future.
 
[Hint: Try looking at the world map]
7.Story: Hi! How are you? Exhausted from your long journey? Here's a tip: whenever you feel tired, just take a moment to enjoy the scenery. Thorns, thunderstorms—you'll forget all about those trifling troubles!
7.Tips: The earth warms you on your journey, while the winds and forests guide your way, allowing you to see the path forward and the beauty all around.
